LM(PC) Rules r.6(1)/6(10): confirm whether 'month and year of manufacture/import' must be displayed on e-commerce listings (currently 'recommended', store-owned) or only on the package.
Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020: confirm the exact sub-rule (cited as r.6(5)) requiring sellers to give country of origin and expiry date.
LM(PC) Amendment Rules 2026 r.6(10A) country-of-origin search/sort filter: confirm commencement date (reported 1 Jul 2026).

Gold hallmarking is mandatory only in notified districts; decide whether 'purity'/'hallmarked' are statutory for every store or only for stores in notified districts, and whether silver HUID (voluntary scheme, IS 2112:2025) needs any flag.
BIS (Hallmarking) Regulations 2018 invoice contents (net weight, purity, hallmarking charges shown separately) are unverified.

BEE mandatory star-label list keeps changing (ceiling fans 2022/2024, washing machines 2023, refrigerators/TVs/others reportedly from 1 Jan 2026, Appliance Labelling Regulations 2025). Need an authoritative per-product-type list to decide when 'star_rating' is statutory vs optional.

BIS CRS (R-number), Footwear QCOs and Toys QCO require marks on the product, not a listing declaration; kept as recommended/optional. Confirm whether the catalogue should require the R-number for CRS-notified goods. Toys QCO 2020 citation unverified here.
Battery Waste Management (Amendment) Rules 2025 QR/EPR requirement is unverified.
Cosmetics: imported-cosmetic registration number requirement and r.34 sub-clause numbers unverified; batch-number exemption for small packs (<=10 g / <=25 ml) reported but unverified.
